title: lazy-sunday tangy tunisian poppy seeds tagine
description: a tangy and crunchy tunisian dish featuring ground poppy seeds, perfect for a lazy sunday morning meal, vegan and raw-friendly

ingredients.name: ferment-jang
ingredients.notes: make sure it's fermented for at least 24 hours before using

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.notes: use mild olive oil for best flavor

ingredients.name: onion
ingredients.notes: chop it finely before adding to the pan

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.notes: mince them finely before adding to the pan

ingredients.name: cumin
ingredients.notes: use freshly ground cumin for best flavor

ingredients.name: coriander
ingredients.notes: use freshly ground coriander for best flavor

ingredients.name: paprika
ingredients.notes: use sweet paprika for best flavor

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.notes: use fine sea salt for best flavor

ingredients.name: fresh parsley
ingredients.notes: chopped before adding to the tagine

instructions: heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat
add the chopped onion and saut3e until it's translucent
add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute
add the ground poppy seeds, cumin, coriander, paprika and salt. stir to combine
add the ferment-jang and stir to combine
reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes
stir in the chopped parsley and cook for an additional 2 minutes
serve the tagine hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired
